title: Meta-learning accelerates detector design optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.35827v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The quality of a detector design is ultimately determined by the quality of the inference it enables, that is, by the accuracy with which the quantities of interest are reconstructed from the raw detector response. For complex detectors, the inference is performed by machine learning models, and the relation between the design and the attainable inference performance is, in general, non-trivial. In this work, we consider the optimization of the inference performance with respect to the detector design. The conventional approach prescribes retraining the inference model at every candidate design, thus, treating the evaluations as independent tasks and discarding the shared structure of the optimal inference algorithms at different designs. translated_title: 元学习加速探测器设计优化
translated_abstract: 探测器设计的质量最终取决于它所能实现的推理质量，即从原始探测器响应中重建感兴趣物理量的准确程度。对于复杂探测器而言，推理由机器学习模型完成，而设计与可达到的推理性能之间的关系通常是非平凡的。在这项工作中，我们考虑了以探测器设计为变量对推理性能进行优化。传统方法要求在每个候选设计处重新训练推理模型，从而将各次评估视为相互独立的任务，丢弃了不同设计下最优推理算法之间共享的结构。我们提出元学习目标估计（MLOE）：不再在每个候选设计处重新求解推理问题，而是使用一个以设计为条件、经过训练的单一元推理模型……
tldr: 提出元学习目标估计（MLOE）方法，通过一个以探测器设计为条件的单一元推理模型替代在每个候选设计处重新训练推理模型，利用不同设计间的共享结构来加速探测器设计的优化。
en_tdlr: We propose the Meta-Learned Objective Estimate (MLOE), which replaces per-design retraining of inference models with a single design-conditioned meta-inference model, leveraging shared structure across candidate designs to accelerate detector design optimization.
